SELECT
    -- 1
    CASE WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'A' THEN 'APPROVED'
    WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' THEN 'DECLINED'
    ELSE 'PENDING' END AS STATUS,

    -- 2

    -- 3
    CASE WHEN MAX(APPM_DATE_MAINT) >= MAX(APPM_DELTA_DATE) THEN MAX(APPM_DATE_MAINT)
    ELSE MAX(APPM_DELTA_DATE) END AS APP_DATE,

    -- 4 to 16
    APPM_DATE_INPUT,
    APPM_NBR,
    APPM_PDT_NBR,
    APPM_CURRENT_STEP,
    APPM_ACC_DCL_IND,
    APPM_GEMP_ZIP,
    APPM_FORMAT_ID,
    APPM_DATE_MAINT,
    APPM_PRIN_FNAME,
    APPM_PRIN_MNAME,
    APPM_PRIN_LNAME,
    APPM_DELTA_DATE,

    -- 17 to 20
    SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 1, 3) AS PGM_CODE,
    SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 4, 3) AS MAIN_SALES_CHNL,
    SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 17, 4) AS SUB_PGM_CODE,
    SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE, 7, 4) AS BRANCH_CODE,

    -- 21
    CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('DD',APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DD_TAG,

    -- 22
    APPM_AGENT_CODE,

    --23
    --24

    --25 to 28
    APPM_REF_NAME AS REF_NAME,
    APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT AS ACCT_CRLIMIT,
    APPM_LOCAL_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    APPM_CARD_IND AS CARD_IND,

    -- 29 to 30
    YEAR(APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS YR_STATUS,
    MONTH(APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS MON_STATUS,

    -- 31 CNT

    -- 32 to 36 ** FINALIZING*

    -- 37 to 40
    MONTH(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_MONTH,
    YEAR(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_YEAR,
    APPM_GEMP_ADDR2,
    APPM_PORA_BPLACE AS DATE_TRANSMITTED,

    --41

    --42
    CASE WHEN APPM_INPUT_OPERATOR = 'BATCH UPLD' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, APPM_DATE_INPUT) ELSE APPM_DATE_INPUT
    END AS APPM_DATE_INPUT2,

    -- 43
    APPM_PORA_CUR_ADDR AS DATE_RECEIVED,

    -- 44 
    CASE WHEN GEMP_ZIP.DD_TAG = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS Deviation,

    --45
    CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(APPM_GEMP_ADDR2, 1, 2) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Reprocessed_tag,

    --46-48
    DATEPART(WEEK, APPM_DELTA_DATE) AS WEEK_STATUS,
    MONTH(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_MONTH,
    YEAR(APPM_DATE_INPUT) AS APPM_ASC_YEAR,

    --49
    CASE
        WHEN APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_PAST_DUE = '' THEN 'Applicant has no TU record at all or OBC CL<25K'
        WHEN (CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER1 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD1 = '2')
             OR (APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER2 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD2 = '2')
             OR (APPM_ACC_DCL_IND = 'D' AND APPM_GEMP_ZIP = 'IC' AND APPM_EXT_ISSUER3 = '0013' AND APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD3 = '2')
        THEN 'The PNB card submitted is either non-existing, with findings, or does not meet the minimum OBC criteria'
        ELSE 'OBC Provided is Secured/Supplementary/Corporate/Prepaid/Debit or is Cancelled'
    END AS SUB_DECL_REASON


FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        APPM_NBR AS GEMP_APPM_NBR,
        CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('DD', APPM_GEMP_ZIP) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DD_TAG
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP
) AS GEMP_ZIP ON BUSC.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP.APPM_NBR = GEMP_ZIP.GEMP_APPM_NBR


GROUP BY
    APPM_ACC_DCL_IND, APPM_DELTA_DATE, APPM_DATE_INPUT, APPM_NBR, APPM_PDT_NBR,
    APPM_CURRENT_STEP, APPM_GEMP_ZIP, APPM_FORMAT_ID, APPM_DATE_MAINT,
    APPM_PRIN_FNAME, APPM_PRIN_MNAME, APPM_PRIN_LNAME, APPM_DELTA_DATE,
    APPM_SOURCE, APPM_AGENT_CODE, APPM_REF_NAME, APPM_ACCT_CRLIMIT, APPM_LOCAL_NAME,
    APPM_CARD_IND, APPM_GEMP_ADDR2, APPM_PORA_BPLACE, APPM_INPUT_OPERATOR, APPM_PORA_CUR_ADDR, GEMP_ZIP.DD_TAG,APPM_PAST_DUE,
    APPM_EXT_ISSUER1, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD1, APPM_EXT_ISSUER2, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD2, APPM_EXT_ISSUER3, APPM_EXT_CARD_VLD3
